capabilities.tables: builds the §6 table model and resolves §5.2 coordinates over it
capabilities.views: derives the relation a §6.1 view publishes
capabilities.ids: reports a document's block ids, declared and derived (§4)
capabilities.addresses: lists a document's addresses: block and heading ids, §4 prose addresses, #meta
capabilities.blocks: exposes the block tree: each block's type, id, classes, attributes and body
capabilities.diagnostics: reports each diagnostic with the code and severity Appendix A assigns it
capabilities.bytes: reads a document from bytes, decoding UTF-8 as §0.1 requires
capabilities.yaml: ships a yaml engine; §3.2 makes it optional and fixes the subset one must read
capabilities.host: reads the files a document names through a host confined to a directory tree (§3.3, §9.3, §9.4)
